meta.title: Fix UI flickering in TradingView component
meta.body_summary: Attempt to fix UI flickering by optimizing useTradingViewProps hook, consolidating setTimeout delays, and improving loading state; ultimately closed as wrong component targeted.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted TradingView flickering fix but closed PR realizing the issue was in token asset details, not TradingView; no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 202 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small edit. The PR was closed as misdirected, not due to size.

review_details.concern_detail: Devin bot closed PR, stating the flickering issue is in the token asset details page, not the TradingView component.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent UI flickering in TradingView by optimizing hooks and loading state management.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent misidentified the source of the UI flickering issue, applying a fix to the TradingView component when the actual problem was in a different page; demonstrates process boundary in problem scoping.
